findings.evidence: Chiswell.lean:340-359 (`smulPair`) and Chiswell.lean:420-441 and 446-466 (instance body and `smul_mk` statement) contain the same `if h : 2 • a ≤ l k + l g - l (k * g) then mk k ⟨l k - a, ...⟩ else mk (k * g) ⟨a + l (k * g) - l g, ...⟩` with identical `htri`/`grind` proofs.

summary: The PR proves two things twice instead of deriving them from one general version: the Chiswell `SMul` instance repeats the private `smulPair` construction verbatim, and `IsTree.four_point` re-proves what the general single-base-point lemma in the same file already gives.
